tier_taxonomy.T1_exact: Exact textual or byte-level match to task answer, patch, hidden key or evaluation artifact.
tier_taxonomy.T2_syntactic: Normalized or structurally equivalent source/diff/answer match.
tier_taxonomy.T3_semantic: Semantically equivalent answer, issue paraphrase or implementation strategy match.
tier_taxonomy.T4_task_level: Benchmark metadata, task identity, hidden tests, expected outcomes or task-specific answer leakage.

policies.no_match_is_not_absence: searched_no_match_found means no match was found in the listed/searchable surfaces at the recorded time. It does not prove no training exposure, no unindexed copy or no inaccessible mirror.
policies.training_exposure: Unknown is the default. independently_tested_no_evidence is a scoped finding, not proof of absence. Never label training exposure clean.
policies.holdout: A public issue/fix pair cannot be called sealed holdout. Holdout review requires private or not-published fix visibility, answer-key custody outside the agent workspace, and complete surface coverage or explicit not_available reasons.
policies.evidence: Every assessment and search surface carries a record digest, reviewer and time; missing or unavailable surfaces remain explicit.

claim_boundary: Design-only transparency registry. No real task contamination card has been created or assessed.
